AI error (e.g., recommending 60% to search when client prioritizes market share in emerging channels) causes misallocated spend and Q revenue miss.
RECOMMENDATION: AI Layer — Build budget recommendation engine: (1) pull prior quarter performance by channel (spend, ROI, CTR, CAC, LTV contribution) from ad platforms; (2) model spend elasticity: if search budget +20%, what ROAS uplift (based on historical curve); (3) stress-test three scenarios: (A) maximize ROAS (allocate to highest ROI channel), (B) optimize for volume (allocate to highest-conversion channel), (C) balanced growth (current mix + 10% to underperformers). Surface each scenario with projected outcomes (€X spend, €Y revenue, Z% ROI). Decision Layer — Strategy Lead or Client Strategist: (1) interpret client's Q goals (revenue maximization vs. market share vs. brand reach) — AI cannot infer this, (2) evaluate channel synergies (e.g., display supports search intent, AI doesn't model this), (3) account for client constraints (e.g., "we're testing TikTok for brand lift, allocate €50k regardless of ROI") — organizational and relational knowledge, (4) decide final allocation given risk tolerance (client is risk-averse vs. experimental). Human must own the decision; AI surfaces data. Setup: 8h (build historical performance model), then monthly (1h per analysis).
DECISION_LAYER: full
AGENT_PHASE: 2
AGENT_LABEL: Phase 2: Supervised (AI models scenarios; human decides allocation based on strategy)
AGENT_MILESTONE: Deliver 3 budget scenarios with projected spend, revenue, and ROI for each, 5 days before client call. Decision documented in approval memo.
ORCHESTRATION: Monthly trigger (15th) → pull Q performance data by channel → model elasticity curves → generate 3 scenarios with financials → surface in executive brief (PDF/Slides). Strategy Lead reviews, elicits client priorities in separate meeting, decides allocation, documents rationale. Human decision is non-delegable due to strategy, risk, and implicit org knowledge.
